name: Netflix
outlook:
What Netflix says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenueIn Q4, we expect revenue of $13.4 billion, which represents year over year growth of 12% (or 11% F/X neutral) driven by growth in memberships, pricing, and ad revenue.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: operating marginWe project a Q4 operating margin of 26.0% which includes ~120 basis points negative impact associated with our recently announced headcount reductions, and compares with 24.5% in the year ago quarter.
  • Full year 2026: revenue and operating marginFor 2026, we expect revenue of $51.1B (+13% year over year) and an operating margin of 31.5%.
  • Full year 2026: free cash flowWe have adjusted our expected 2026 FCF forecast to approximately $12.0B (vs. our prior projection of $12.5B) due primarily to the expected closing of a real estate transaction in Q4.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 20, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
